frontier_lineage: openai/gpt-4o (upstream corpus generation, per the dataset card)

csam_exclusion.filters: Upstream corpus filtering by the dataset publishers (AI2 responsible-use terms for WildGuardMix; expert validation for ExpGuardMix) plus no image or binary content in any row -- these corpora are text-only. No new web crawl is performed by this pipeline.
csam_exclusion.limitation: This attests to the pipeline's own inputs and to the publishers' stated process. It is not an independent audit of either upstream corpus.

frontier_lineage: openai/gpt-4o (upstream corpus generation, per the dataset card)
notes: selector=weak-category, benign_ratio=1.0, 0 row(s) dropped for an absent or unrecognised label
categories targeted: Unqualified Professional Advice=1173, Privacy Violation=1584, Violence & Incitement=2284, Self-Harm & Suicide Promotion=595 -- each name with the number of unsafe rows it matched

source file reconciled against the registry: --rows expguardtrain.parquet matches the file expguardmix:train declares (expguardtrain.parquet). FILENAME check only -- no published content digest exists to compare the bytes against, so this catches the wrong file and cannot catch a renamed one.
hold-out NOT verified at build time: no eval split was supplied to the builder. The parity gate performs its own leakage check and will refuse the candidate if this corpus overlaps the eval set.
